turnaround_reason: Charter cratered ~65% from its 52-week high on accelerating broadband subscriber losses (120k lost in Q1 2026 vs ~100k expected) amid fixed-wireless and fiber competition. The bull case: extreme cheapness (forward P/E ~3.4, EV/EBITDA ~5.5) on a business still generating ~$2.2B FCF, a large insider buy cluster, a big short position, and the pending Cox merger as a hard catalyst.
bullish_points: Dirt cheap on cash flow: forward P/E ~3.4, EV/EBITDA ~5.5, price/book ~1.07, generating ~$2.2B FCF and $16.5B operating cash flow TTM
Strong insider conviction cluster: net +1.58M shares purchased over 6m across 21 transactions, led by CEO Winfrey and multiple directors buying with their own capital ($1M-$1.4M each)
Cox merger (~$21.9B, ~$34.5B incl. debt) received FCC/DOJ clearance, expected to close summer 2026, with ~$800M of targeted operating synergies and Spectrum brand extension
Aggressive buybacks shrinking the share count (4.3M shares / ~$963M in Q1 alone) at prices well above current
Very high short interest at ~51% of float — sets up squeeze potential on any positive subscriber/merger surprise
Mobile remains a genuine growth engine (~12M lines and climbing), partially offsetting broadband erosion
bearish_points: Core broadband subs still shrinking, and the losses are widening vs estimates — the fundamental erosion is not yet arrested
Enormous leverage: ~$96.7B total debt, D/E ~441%, current ratio 0.36 — refinancing/rate risk is real and Cox adds more debt
Revenue declining (-1.7% TTM); the thesis relies on cost synergies and buybacks, not top-line growth
Cord-cutting and fixed-wireless/fiber competition are secular, not cyclical, headwinds
Integration risk on a merger this size; synergy realization is multi-year and never guaranteed
catalyst: Cox merger close (summer 2026) plus subsequent quarterly broadband net-adds inflection; continued buybacks and deleveraging as FCF compounds
catalyst_timing: Cox close targeted summer 2026; next earnings 2026-10-30
suggested_trade: Spot, medium starter position now with room to add on a broadband net-add inflection. For leverage, Jan 2027 $160-180 calls given elevated but not extreme IV (~58%)
key_risk: Broadband subscriber losses keep accelerating and fixed-wireless takes more share, so the 'cheap' multiple is a value trap on a structurally declining, over-levered asset
would_skip_if: Cox deal breaks or is materially repriced, or Q3 broadband losses accelerate again with no mobile offset
